mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the threads to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: it brought the two parts together and showed how the leak stopped without pretending the skin had healed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was straightforward setup rather than an especially interesting decision, though it made the location of the leak clear.

surprise.text: The platelet plug slowed the bleeding but left the surface cut open; even the reinforced clot did not finish healing the skin.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary. The item pictures and labels gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the still-open skin heals after the bleeding stops, although this chapter's pairings were mostly straightforward.
